# 2 Baruch Chapter 39 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Third Fast and Vision

---

**1** Now hear the interpretation of the cedar vision.

**2** The great forest you saw represents four kingdoms that will rule over your people. Their reign will be one of turmoil and distress.

**3** And the cedar you saw left standing from the forest — the vine coming to overpower it and bring it to nothing with water —

**4** This is what it means: the last ruler remaining from that evil forest — the one who will have commanded them all — will be captured and brought to Mount Zion.

**5** There my Anointed One will expose all his wickedness and gather all his forces against him.

**6** And then my Anointed One will execute him and protect the rest of my people who survive in the place I have chosen.

**7** And his reign will endure forever — until the corrupt world has come to its end and the appointed times have been completed.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering of the messianic interpretation. The four kingdoms scheme (v.2) echoes Daniel 2/7. The Messiah's role is forensic (expose wickedness), martial (execute the last ruler), and pastoral (protect the remnant). The messianic reign is everlasting but within history.*
